q: The Chu construction Chu(Set,2) produces a star-autonomous category (a model of multiplicative linear logic). Its objects are pairs (X,A,r) with r: X×A → 2, which can represent:
opts: Games (X = positions of player 1, A = strategies of player 2, r = winner)
exp: Chu spaces (X,A,r) model various structures in a unified way: r: X×A → 2 can be membership (topology: X = points, A = open sets), strategies (game theory: X = moves, A = counter-moves, r = outcome), or binary relations. The Chu construction is a universal way to build star-autonomous categories.
